text:
Sam: Crumb countdown at 11:58 — who wants to judge the microwave symphony? Winner gets the last mini muffin. :muffin:
Eli: I will judge but only if there is dramatic narration. 'And now, a lone toast emerges...' :open_mouth:
Rina: Entering one-liner duel while we snack. 1 line, no repeats. Bragging rights and a sticker for the champ.
Sam: My line: 'My coffee is undercover as a desk plant.' :coffee: :seedling:
Eli: 'Calendar invites are just polite suggestions.' :calendar:
Rina: 'I whisper to my laptop for motivation.' :laptop: :sparkles:
ops-bot: Reminder: Quiet rooms reserved 12:00-13:00 for interviews. Please keep applause to thumbs-up only.
Sam: Also fridge etiquette PSA: if it's labeled with a sad-face Post-it, don't eat it. It has feelings. :pensive:
Eli: Poll: React with :thumbsup: if you want to join the crumb countdown. I'll tally at 11:55.
Rina: :thumbsup:
Eli: :thumbsup:
Sam: OK 3 judges. Muffin will be awarded by majority cheer level (measured in subtle nods).
Rina: Loser must pen a haiku about the office stapler. Fair?
Eli: Fair. I'll practice my haiku voice. See you at 11:58. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
